title: Covered Months of the Seat Waiver by the Source of the Meal Status (Student Transportation Services)
content:
The covered months of a Student Transportation Services seat waiver follow the source the meal status on file in the School Nutrition Services Meal Account rests on. The seat waiver is multiplied by the covered months divided by the seat months, the seat months being the whole calendar months from the month the seat fee posted through the last month of its permit period (December for a fall semester fee, May otherwise), that month included. The covered months are never below zero and never exceed the seat months.

| Meal status on file | Covered months |
|---|---|
| carried over from the prior school year: Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) or Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted up to, but not including, the month of the status's carryover last operating day, plus that month counted as one month (1) when the carryover last operating day falls after the 20th day of its month, as half a month (0.5) when it falls on the 11th through the 20th day, and as nothing when it falls on or before the 10th day |
| a reduction pending: the meal account's latest benefit notice is an adverse action notice dated after the day the status on file took effect | the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through the month of that adverse action notice, never below zero, because a reduction after verification takes effect only after the adverse action notice period of 7 CFR 245.6a |
| any other status | all the seat months |

The latest benefit notice is the one with the latest notice date; an adverse action notice that shares the latest notice date with another notice is the latest. The carryover last operating day is the one the meal status publishes in the School Nutrition Services Meal Account. A carried-over status is counted by the first row.

## Cases (hypothetical, school-year seat fee posted in October, 8 seat months)

| Status on file | Covered months |
|---|---|
| carried over, carryover last operating day on December 24 | October, November: 2, plus 1: 3 |
| carried over, carryover last operating day on December 15 | 2, plus 0.5: 2.5 |
| carried over, carryover last operating day on December 8 | 2 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status, latest notice an adverse action notice dated February 2, after the status took effect | October through February: 5 |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application), latest notice an approval letter | 8 |
